WITH latest_flows AS (
                    SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
                    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
                ),
                latest_regime AS (
                    SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history
                    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
                ),
                latest_breadth AS (
                    SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily
                    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
                ),
                latest_index AS (
                    SELECT * FROM market.index_eod
                    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
                      AND index_symbol = 'NIFTY_50'
                )
                SELECT rf.trade_date, rf.fii_net_5d, rf.dii_net_5d, rh.regime, rh.confidence,
                       md.net_ad, md.ad_signal, ieod.close, ieod.change_pct
                FROM latest_flows rf
                JOIN latest_regime rh ON rf.trade_date = rh.trade_date
                JOIN latest_breadth md ON rf.trade_date = md.trade_date
                JOIN latest_index ieod ON rf.trade_date = ieod.trade_date
                ORDER BY rf.trade_date DESC
                LIMIT 5;

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, pct_above_50dma, breadth_signal
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
),
latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, symbol, stage_score, trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
)
SELECT lb.sector, lb.pct_above_50dma, lb.breadth_signal, ls.symbol, ls.trading_signal
FROM latest_breadth lb
LEFT JOIN latest_stage ls ON lb.sector = ls.sector
WHERE ls.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY lb.breadth_signal DESC, ls.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH latest_vcp AS (
    SELECT 
        vcp.symbol, 
        vcp.price, 
        ss.enhanced_fund_score, 
        ss.stage 
    FROM 
        scores.stage2_vcp_picks vcp 
    JOIN 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss 
    ON 
        vcp.symbol = ss.symbol 
    WHERE 
        vcp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
        AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
        AND ss.enhanced_fund_score > 8 
    ORDER BY 
        ss.enhanced_fund_score DESC, 
        vcp.vcp_score DESC
    LIMIT 50
) 
SELECT 
    symbol, 
    price, 
    enhanced_fund_score, 
    stage 
FROM 
    latest_vcp;

sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest market context combining FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data.
sql_templates.name: latest_market_context
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) as max_date FROM market.index_eod),
latest_flows AS (
    SELECT * FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT * FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT * FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT * FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date)
)
SELECT 
    f.trade_date, 
    f.flow_signal, 
    r.regime, 
    b.ad_signal, 
    i.index_symbol, 
    i.change_pct
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50';

sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest insider alerts and bulk deals with technical confirmation for the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: insider_deal_alerts
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_insider_alerts AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.alert_type, ia.entity, ia.qty, ia.value_cr, ia.insider_score,
        bb.deal_date, bb.deal_type, bb.qty AS deal_qty, bb.price, bb.side, ss.stage, ss.technical_score
    FROM 
        signals.insider_alerts ia
    JOIN 
        signals.bulk_block_deals bb ON ia.symbol = bb.symbol
    JOIN 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
    WHERE 
        ia.alert_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
        AND bb.deal_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
        AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT * FROM recent_insider_alerts
ORDER BY insider_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.name: corporate_events_results_watchlist
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_stage_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        symbol, 
        sector, 
        stage, 
        trading_signal, 
        snapshot_date 
    FROM 
        scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE 
        snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
        AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
),
latest_corporate_events AS (
    SELECT 
        id, 
        symbol, 
        event_type, 
        event_date
    FROM 
        signals.corporate_events
    WHERE 
        event_date >= CURRENT_DATE
        OR event_date = (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM signals.corporate_events)
),
latest_results_analysis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol)
        symbol, 
        period_end, 
        verdict
    FROM 
        scores.results_analysis
    ORDER BY 
        symbol, period_end DESC NULLS LAST, updated_at DESC
)
SELECT 
    e.symbol,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_date,
    r.verdict,
    s.stage,
    s.trading_signal
FROM 
    latest_corporate_events e
JOIN 
    latest_stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol
LEFT JOIN 
    latest_results_analysis r ON e.symbol = r.symbol
WHERE 
    e.event_type IN ('RESULTS', 'DIVIDEND', 'SPLIT', 'BONUS', 'AGM')
LIMIT 50;

WITH latest_trade_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
) 
SELECT

    f.fii_net_today, 
    f.dii_net_today, 
    r.regime, 
    b.ad_signal,

JOIN

sql_templates.description: Fetch sectors with improving breadth and stage participation in the last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots),
breadth_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.sector, 
        sd.pct_above_50dma,
        ma.stage2_pct
    FROM 
        breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN 
        breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    WHERE 
        sd.snapshot_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days')
),
stage_2_sectors AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.sector,
        COUNT(ss.symbol) AS stage_2_count
    FROM 
        scores.stage_snapshots ss
    WHERE 
        ss.stage = 'STAGE_2' AND 
        ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_snapshots)
    GROUP BY 
        ss.sector
)
SELECT 
    bd.sector,
    bd.pct_above_50dma,
    stage_2_count
FROM 
    breadth_data bd
LEFT JOIN 
    stage_2_sectors s2 ON bd.sector = s2.sector
ORDER BY 
    pct_above_50dma DESC, 
    stage_2_count DESC 
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Select improving sectors based on latest breadth and stage analysis.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_sector_data AS (
  SELECT
    sector,
    MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
  FROM
    breadth.sector_daily
  GROUP BY
    sector
),
sector_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    s.sector,
    s.breadth_signal,
    m.stage2_pct
  FROM
    breadth.sector_daily s
    JOIN latest_sector_data l ON s.sector = l.sector AND s.snapshot_date = l.latest_date
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above m ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
  WHERE
    s.change_5d >= 0 -- improvement in last 5 sessions
)
SELECT
  sa.sector,
  sa.breadth_signal,
  sa.stage2_pct
FROM
  sector_analysis sa
WHERE
  sa.stage2_pct > 20 -- active stage 2 participation
ORDER BY
  sa.stage2_pct DESC
LIMIT 5; -- concise table output

sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data.
sql_templates.name: combined_market_review
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_data AS (
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS max_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
)
SELECT 
    flow.trade_date, 
    flow.fii_net_today, 
    flow.dii_net_today, 
    flow.flow_signal, 
    reg.regime, 
    reg.confidence, 
    breadth.advances, 
    breadth.declines, 
    breadth.ad_signal, 
    index_data.close, 
    index_data.trend_signal
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows AS flow
JOIN signals.regime_history AS reg ON flow.trade_date = reg.trade_date
JOIN breadth.market_daily AS breadth ON flow.trade_date = breadth.trade_date
JOIN market.index_eod AS index_data ON flow.trade_date = index_data.trade_date
AND index_data.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
WHERE flow.trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data);

sql_templates.description: Rank sectors by breadth signal and Stage 2 participation within the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, 
           MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
), 
ranked_sectors AS (
    SELECT sd.sector, 
           sd.breadth_signal, 
           ma.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma
    ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    JOIN latest_stage ls
    ON sd.sector = ls.sector
    WHERE sd.snapshot_date = ls.max_snapshot_date
    AND sd.snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_sectors;

def run(context):
    fii_flow = context.inputs['fii_net_today']
    dii_flow = context.inputs['dii_net_today']
    regime = context.inputs['regime']
    ad_signal = context.inputs['ad_signal']
    trin_signal = context.inputs['trin_signal']

    flags = []

    if fii_flow > 0 and dii_flow > 0:
        flags.append('Positive Institutional Inflows')

    if regime == 'BULL' and ad_signal == 'BUY' and trin_signal == 'BULLISH':
        flags.append('Risk-On')
    elif regime == 'BEAR' or ad_signal == 'SELL' or trin_signal == 'BEARISH':
        flags.append('Risk-Off')
    else:
        flags.append('Neutral')

    context.outputs['risk_flags'] = flags

    return context.outputs

index_returns.description: Calculates the percentage return of indexes over the past 3 months.
index_returns.template:
WITH three_months_data AS (
    SELECT index_symbol, close as close_price, trade_date
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT index_symbol, 
       (SELECT close_price FROM three_months_data ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 1) / 
       (SELECT close_price FROM three_months_data ORDER BY trade_date ASC LIMIT 1) - 1 AS return_pct
FROM three_months_data
GROUP BY index_symbol
LIMIT 100;

tool_plan_template.code:
def run(context):
            # Obtain connection and cursor from context
            conn = context['conn']
            cursor = conn.cursor()

            # SQL to retrieve the latest run_id for today's report
            sql_latest_run = """
            SELECT run_id
            FROM report.enhanced_runs
            WHERE run_ts >= CURRENT_DATE
            ORDER BY run_ts DESC
            LIMIT 1
            """
            cursor.execute(sql_latest_run)
            result = cursor.fetchone()
            if result:
                latest_run_id = result[0]
                # Now, verify existence of filtered stocks for this run
                sql_stock_check = """
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks
                WHERE run_id = %s
                """
                cursor.execute(sql_stock_check, (latest_run_id,))
                count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
                if count > 0:
                    return {'findings': 'Data validated.', 'broken_links': 0, 'missing_data': 0, 'remediation': 'None needed', 'verification': 'Confirmed stocks exist for latest run.'}
            return {'findings': 'No valid data found.', 'broken_links': 1, 'missing_data': 1, 'remediation': 'Check report generation process.', 'verification': 'No stocks exist for today.'}

description: Combine FII/DII flow trend, market regime, breadth, and index evidence to explain market risk-on or risk-off context. Variant focus: deep institutional review; timeframe: last 5 sessions; response style: portfolio-aware output.

sql_templates.description: Fetch data for FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index for last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: fii_dii_regime_breadth_query
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_data AS ( 
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) as max_date 
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows 
), 
flow_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_5d, dii_net_5d, flow_signal 
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
regime_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence 
    FROM signals.regime_history 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
breadth_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, advances, declines, ad_signal 
    FROM breadth.market_daily 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
index_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct 
    FROM market.index_eod 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' 
) 
SELECT fd.trade_date, fd.fii_net_5d, fd.dii_net_5d, fd.flow_signal, rd.regime, rd.confidence, bd.advances, bd.declines, bd.ad_signal, id.close, id.change_pct 
FROM flow_data fd 
JOIN regime_data rd ON fd.trade_date = rd.trade_date 
JOIN breadth_data bd ON fd.trade_date = bd.trade_date 
JOIN index_data id ON fd.trade_date = id.trade_date;

synthesis_guidance: ['Analyze flow_signal and ad_signal for risk-on/off insights.', 'Use regime and index confirmation to support flow analysis.', 'Provide portfolio-aware output leveraging breadth and regime context.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1422

sql_templates.description: Identify sectors with improving breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma::numeric) AS avg_pct_above_50dma
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    GROUP BY sector
), latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT b.sector, b.avg_pct_above_50dma, s.stage2_count
FROM latest_breadth b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.sector = s.sector
ORDER BY s.stage2_count DESC, b.avg_pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 5;

sql_templates.description: Get candidate symbols from the top sectors.
sql_templates.query:
SELECT ss.symbol, ss.company_name, ss.stage_score
FROM scores.stage_snapshots ss
JOIN (
    SELECT sector
    FROM (
        SELECT b.sector, s.stage2_count
        FROM (
            SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma::numeric) AS avg_pct_above_50dma
            FROM breadth.sector_daily
            WHERE snapshot_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
            GROUP BY sector
        ) b
        JOIN (
            SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count
            FROM scores.stage_snapshots
            WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
            AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
            GROUP BY sector
        ) s ON b.sector = s.sector
    ) subquery
    ORDER BY stage2_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
) top_sectors ON ss.sector = top_sectors.sector
WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Select sectors with improving breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_ranking
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_date FROM breadth.sector_daily), 
sectors_with_breadth AS (
  SELECT 
    sd.sector, 
    sd.pct_above_50dma, 
    sd.change_5d, 
    sd.breadth_signal, 
    ma.stage2_pct 
  FROM 
    breadth.sector_daily sd 
  JOIN 
    breadth.ma_pct_above ma 
  ON 
    sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date 
  JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots ss 
  ON 
    sd.sector = ss.sector 
  WHERE 
    sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_snapshot) 
    AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND ma.stage2_pct > 50
)
SELECT 
  sector, 
  MAX(pct_above_50dma) AS max_pct_above_50dma, 
  MAX(change_5d) AS max_change_5d, 
  MAX(stage2_pct) AS max_stage2_pct 
FROM 
  sectors_with_breadth 
GROUP BY 
  sector 
ORDER BY 
  max_stage2_pct DESC, 
  max_change_5d DESC 
LIMIT 5;

tool_plan_template.code:
def run(context):
    # Connect to the database and execute SQL
    query = '''
    WITH latest_stage_snapshots AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM scores.stage_snapshots
        WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    )
    SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost, s.price, s.stage, s.trading_signal
    FROM portfolio.holdings h
    JOIN latest_stage_snapshots s ON h.symbol = s.symbol
    '''
    result_set = context.execute(query)

    # Analyze result_set for add/trim decisions
    add_candidates = []
    trim_candidates = []
    for row in result_set:
        if row['trading_signal'] in ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY'):
            add_candidates.append(row['symbol'])
        elif row['trading_signal'] == 'SELL':
            trim_candidates.append(row['symbol'])

    return {
        'portfolio_state': result_set,
        'add_candidates': add_candidates,
        'trim_candidates': trim_candidates
    }

FROM fii_dii_recent f
JOIN regime_recent r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date

JOIN index_recent i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date;

sql_templates.insider_bulk_deals_query:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal, stage_score, technical_score, snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_eod AS (
    SELECT symbol, close, volume
    FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
)
SELECT b.symbol, b.deal_date, b.qty, b.price, i.alert_date, i.insider_score, s.stage, s.trading_signal
FROM signals.bulk_block_deals b
JOIN latest_stage s ON b.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN latest_eod e ON b.symbol = e.symbol
LEFT JOIN signals.insider_alerts i ON b.symbol = i.symbol
WHERE s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY b.deal_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

sectors_and_stocks.query:
WITH latest_sector_breadth AS (
    SELECT s.sector, s.pct_above_50dma, s.change_5d, m.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily s
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above m ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
    WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
), improving_stocks AS (
    SELECT symbol, sector, stage_score, trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT lsb.sector, lsb.pct_above_50dma, lsb.change_5d, lsb.stage2_pct,
       ist.symbol
FROM latest_sector_breadth lsb
JOIN improving_stocks ist ON lsb.sector = ist.sector
ORDER BY lsb.stage2_pct DESC, ist.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH latest_trade_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows),

)

sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_flows AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    fii_net_5d,
    dii_net_5d,
    flow_signal
  FROM
    signals.fii_dii_flows
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
),
latest_regime AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    regime,
    confidence
  FROM
    signals.regime_history
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM signals.regime_history)
),
latest_breadth AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    adv_signal,
    trin_signal
  FROM
    breadth.market_daily
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM breadth.market_daily)
),
latest_index AS (
  SELECT
    trade_date,
    close,
    trend_signal
  FROM
    market.index_eod
  WHERE
    trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)
    AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT
  lf.trade_date,
  lf.fii_net_5d,
  lf.dii_net_5d,
  lf.flow_signal,
  lr.regime,
  lr.confidence,
  lb.adv_signal,
  lb.trin_signal,
  li.close,
  li.trend_signal
FROM
  latest_flows lf
  JOIN latest_regime lr ON lf.trade_date = lr.trade_date
  JOIN latest_breadth lb ON lf.trade_date = lb.trade_date
  JOIN latest_index li ON lf.trade_date = li.trade_date;

sql_templates.description: Fetch FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index data for last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.name: flow_regime_breadth_index_analysis
sql_templates.statement:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today,
           fi_trend, di_trend
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, adv_volume, dec_volume, ad_signal
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
),
latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, close, change_pct, trend_signal
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' AND trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
)
SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today,
       r.regime, r.confidence,
       b.adv_volume, b.dec_volume, b.ad_signal,
       i.close, i.change_pct, i.trend_signal
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC;

WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.sector_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)),

sql_templates.description: Fetch resolved signals and their outcomes.
sql_templates.template: SELECT symbol, date_issued, signal, hit_target, hit_stop, return_pct FROM signals.signal_log WHERE date_resolved IS NOT NULL;

sql_templates.description: Join latest market prices with signal logs.
sql_templates.template: WITH latest_prices AS (SELECT symbol, MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM market.equity_eod GROUP BY symbol) SELECT s.symbol, s.date_issued, e.close AS latest_close FROM signals.signal_log s JOIN latest_prices lp ON s.symbol = lp.symbol JOIN market.equity_eod e ON lp.symbol = e.symbol AND lp.trade_date = e.trade_date WHERE s.date_resolved IS NOT NULL;
